2527-4076-4279-4549-5332.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-5332.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2577-6495-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-6495-6664-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-6495-6664-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

394-586-728-864-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-728-864-3125.description:
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-4742.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1020-3689-6518-7692.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-2511-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

140-4217-7300.notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
140-4217-7300.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Rowan.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Rowan.
Repeat from step 4.

5173-5553-5626-7056.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

30-147-413.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-147-413.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Storm of Souls.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls.
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-147-413.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

1395-1492-4195-4574.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1395-1492-4195-4574.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3129-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

250-3946-6701.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability and The Gitrog Monster's first ability trigger.
Resolve The Gitrog Monster trigger, sacrificing Glacial Chasm.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, choosing not to pay and doing nothing as Glacial Chasm is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

509-549-1267-5547.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-549-1267-5547.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-3356-3902.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3356-3902.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Polyraptor, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Polyraptor trigger, creating a token copy of it.
When the Polyraptor token enters the battlefield, Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have the Polyraptor token deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Repeat from step 3.

144-419-4050-4893.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix, adding {U}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Activate Ixidor by paying {U}, turning Ashcloud Phoenix face up.
Repeat.

2060-2427-2713-2717-4772.notablePrerequisites: Krasis Incubation attached to Crystalline Crawler.
2060-2427-2713-2717-4772.description:
Activate Krasis Incubation by paying {G}{U} and returning it to your hand, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{G}{U}{U}.
Cast Krasis Incubation by paying {G}{U} due to Mana Matrix, attaching it to Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat.

193-205-2369.description:
Activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to draw a card and then put a card from your hand on top of your library.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Azor.
Azor enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat each turn.

2907-3080-3438.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You control at least five lands.
2907-3080-3438.description:
Activate Inkmoth Nexus' first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Inkmoth Nexus' second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature that is still a land until end of turn.
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}, exchanging the text boxes of Inkmoth Nexus and Scute Swarm.
Play a land.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Inkmoth Nexus's Scute Swarm ability, creating a token copy of Inkmoth Nexus with its original text.
Step 5 repeats in a mandatory loop unless interrupted, drawing the game.

1651-2557-4231-4732-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-2557-4231-4732-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

1485-1530.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
Dowsing Shaman does not have summoning sickness.
1485-1530.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Second Chance and take an extra turn.
Pay {2}{G} and tap Dowsing Shaman to return Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

186-1409-1812-4617.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Soulbright Flamekin.
186-1409-1812-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin 3 times paying {1} each time, adding eight {R} with the third activation.
Activate Prismite for {1} to add {U}.
Pay {U} to activate the ability granted to Soulbright Flamekin by Deadeye Navigator, blinking it.
When it ETBs, pair it with Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat this process for infinite mana.
If you have another creature with an ETB, you can flicker Deadeye and pair it to that creature, then flicker that creature infinite times.

3941-4222-5089.notablePrerequisites: Coveted Jewel does not have summoning sickness.
3941-4222-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Coveted Jewel to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Coveted Jewel.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 2.
